worldcombat.skill.sharpen.summary: Push the body's edges out to raise Attack; while they last, foes who hit you up close are cut by the edges, and the Attack is taken back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.use.0: Raise your edges before a brawl so foes think twice about closing in
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.use.1: When chased, add Attack and leave a cut on the pursuer
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.use.2: Re-raise the edges once they dull to keep the Attack bonus
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.description.0: Push the edges out: Attack +%1$s stage(s); while they are up, each contact attack that hits you makes the attacker take about %2$s physical damage from the edges (their Defence, type match-up and criticals settle then).
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.description.1: The edge window lasts about %1$s and cannot be cast again while it is up; when it runs out or is removed the edges dull and the raised Attack is taken back.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.quick.on: Quick edges: telegraph -2 ticks and cooldown -15, so the edges can be raised again sooner after they dull; the window is x0.75 and edge power x0.9.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.quick.off: Solid edges: telegraph and cooldown as written, for a longer window and a heavier counter.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.timing: The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost; PP is spent and the cooldown starts only once the move goes off.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.growth.0: From level %1$s: edge window %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.growth.1: From level %1$s: edge window %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.preference.qui: On: telegraph -2 ticks and cooldown -15 so the edges can be raised again sooner after they dull, but the window is x0.75 and edge power x0.9. Off: slower and dearer, for a longer window and a heavier counter.
Consider sharpening when a threat is within this distance; larger raises the edges earlier.
Stop sharpening and fight when a threat is closer than this; larger gives it up more often up close.
On: prefer to raise the edges once a foe is within 4 blocks so the contact eats the counter. Off: raise them even at range for the Attack alone.

On: when the threat's last attack was a projectile/spell and it is still beyond melee, the companion holds off raising the edges rather than feeding a ranged pin. Off: ignore the attack kind and decide by distance alone.
world_combat.move.sharpen.text.capped: Edges already at their limit (no Attack gained)
